Remark
[Method of Browder and Minty] ↗ thm:monotonicity-existence-weak-solution 1. ch9:9.1-rem-1\group Nonlinear Elliptic PDE

The method of Browder and Minty uses monotonicity to identify weak limits of nonlinear terms.

Assume additionally that, for some $\theta >0$, \[ (\mathbf a(p)-\mathbf a(q))\cdot (p-q)\geq \theta |p-q|^2 \quad (p,q\in \R ^n). \tag {20} \]
